text:
Maya: heads-up: noticed a cohort where `x-api-version` header != effective route. Some tenants charged under v2 even when served v1 fallback. thinking we need a short-term billing guard. cc @Ravi @Jon
Ravi: do we have a sample log line?
Maya: `[WARN] req=zz1 client=gamma header=v2 routed=v1 billing_tag=v2_detected=false`
Jon: could be proxy stripping headers or SDK defaults. how noisy is this?
Maya: steady low-rate noise + spikes after deploys.
ConsoleBot: alert -> version-header-mismatch rate > threshold (5m)
Priya: two concerns: avoid creating per-tenant billing series, and avoid auto-applying to SLA/Dedicated customers.
Sam: proposal: detector marks token with `billing_safe` and we shadow-bill. Use sampling (0.5%) for aggressive autocohort, rest get shadow logs. Keep `billing_safe` TTL 24h.
Ravi: agree on sampling. Technical rule: if mismatch_rate(token,W)>T => tag(token, "safeguard"); annotate traces with `billing_safe=true` and emit `shadow_bill` events.
Jon: billing pipeline needs to ignore `billing_safe` for quota reclassification and keep invoices unchanged until confirm. Also add a reconcilation job to merge shadow charges if tenant approves.
Priya: console UX: show a non-blocking banner "Version signal irregularities detected 72h. Temporary billing safeguard applied. Review" with actions [Review, Request human review, Dismiss]. Default = safeguard on for new detections.
Maya: SLA rule: if tenant.sla == true => do NOT autocohort; instead notify account team and set pending flag.
Sam: telemetry: add counters `version_mismatch_detected`, `billing_safe_assigned`, `billing_safe_confirmed`, `billing_safe_fp`. Keep aggregated metrics by tier only.
Ravi: rollout plan: run detector in shadow namespace 2w, collect FP rate. If FP < 4% -> enable 5% sample.
Jon: tasks: implement detector + 0.5% sampling (ETA 3d); billing pipeline change (ETA 5d); console mock + copy (ETA 2d); telemetry panel (ETA 2d).
Maya: I'll draft runbook and include manual confirm flow + TTL extension process.
Priya: copy suggestion: "We detected atypical version headers for some requests. We've applied a temporary billing safeguard to prevent unexpected quota changes. Please review."
ConsoleBot: task created #ops-4500 (assignee: Ravi)
Maya: thanks all, moving to implementation threads. :rocket:
